Fixing pre-pickup issues (Address + cut-off + stock) raises on-time to 87.8% (late avoided 8112, cost avoided 801412). Fixing addresses + lanes gives 84.2% on-time; the full pre-pickup + lanes program (Address + cut-off + stock + lanes) reaches 96.3% on-time. \\nSuggestion (from the data, not a decision): the evidence points to pre-pickup fixes delivering more improvement than routing alone: Address + cut-off + stock gives 87.8% on-time, while Carrier lanes + routes gives 80.4% on-time, so pre-pickup fixes would raise on-time higher. What would change this conclusion is stronger replay gains for lanes/routes or weaker adoption of pre-pickup fixes in your data. The decision stays with Halcyon.\",\"refused\":false}"}
